product_backlog.title: Core To-Do List Management and Web UI
product_backlog.description: Core CRUD operations for lists and tasks, plus basic web UI and session storage.

acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the home page, When they enter a list name and click create, Then a new to-do list is created and displayed in the view.
product_backlog.title: Create To-Do List
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can successfully initiate and organize separate lists.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks.
product_backlog.acceptance_check_note: Verified US-0001 acceptance criteria: list creation form and view work correctly.

product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can track what needs to be done.
product_backlog.title: Add Task to List
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing to-do list, When the user adds a task with a text description, Then the task appears within that list.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can break down their lists into actionable task items.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can track what needs to be done.
product_backlog.acceptance_check_note: Verified US-0002 acceptance criteria: adding tasks to lists functions and tests pass successfully.

product_backlog.title: Ensure test fixtures properly reset all global state and counters to prevent inter-test pollution.
product_backlog.overview: Ensure test fixtures properly reset all global state and counters to prevent inter-test pollution.
product_backlog.user_story: As a developer, I want test fixtures to properly reset all global state so that tests are isolated and reliable.
acceptance_criteria: Given test execution starts, When any test runs, Then all global state, counters, and mocks are cleanly reset.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Reliable tests prevent false positives and test pollution.
product_backlog.description: Ensure test fixtures properly reset all global state and counters to prevent inter-test pollution.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can track task completion status visually.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, When the user clicks to mark it complete or incomplete, Then its status toggles and is visually updated.
product_backlog.title: Mark Task Complete or Incomplete
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can monitor my progress.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can monitor my progress.

product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove unwanted or obsolete items.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task in a list, When the user clicks delete on the task, Then the task is removed from the list.
product_backlog.title: Delete Task
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can clean up individual tasks they no longer need.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove unwanted or obsolete items.

acceptance_criteria: Given an existing to-do list, When the user clicks delete on the list, Then the entire list and its associated tasks are removed.
product_backlog.title: Delete Entire List
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can remove obsolete categories of work.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users can delete entire lists and all contained tasks cleanly.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can remove obsolete categories of work.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Users have a complete overview of all their lists and task states.
product_backlog.description: As a user, I want to see all my lists and tasks with completed items visually distinguished so that I have a clear overview.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has multiple lists and tasks, When they view the main page, Then all lists and their respective tasks are visible, with completed tasks visually distinguished.
product_backlog.title: View All Lists and Tasks
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to see all my lists and tasks with completed items visually distinguished so that I have a clear overview.

specs/ROADMAP.md updated via update_roadmap to reflect this story's completed status

This is sprint 2 of 5. Continue the product vision from before - check the existing repo content (specs/, code, .hc/state.json) before planning, so you build on what's already there rather than repeating or contradicting it. As before: the sprint goal and backlog are pre-approved. Start by calling start_sprint(goal) to officially kick off this sprint - it mechanically resets the sprint's own token/event budget, so skipping it leaves this sprint silently running on whatever budget the previous sprint already spent. Then proceed directly through planning, development, PR creation, CI verification, sprint review (create_sprint_report), and the release PR (create_release_pr) without waiting for further approval. Do not ask me anything else during this sprint.
